entries.38b3a62069c6945b: In the frozen tofu division, which uses soybeans as its raw material, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,352 million. Centered on 'Shin Asahi Tofu', it conducts public relations on health functionality and develops products by application.
entries.5e8f021a1c90b34b: In the division for processed foods such as instant miso soup, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,336 million. It manufactures and sells products such as 'Nama Misozui' and cup-type products.
entries.7699089dbff2ffa1: Other food products, such as medical food ingredients
entries.78cceeb6da96f06c: Processed foods such as instant miso soup
entries.7e3601cd9ebcd25d: A food manufacturer that produces and sells foods such as freeze-dried tofu, instant miso soup and medical-use food ingredients.
entries.ac5d0edeee1bbd46: A single-segment business that manufactures and sells food products, including frozen tofu and processed foods. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,686 million. This business consists of the company and its consolidated subsidiary Asahimatsu Fresh System Co., Ltd., which transports and stores the company's products and transports and purchases raw materials.
entries.ca0981868ff8f3c7: In the division handling medical food ingredients, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,998 million. Medical food ingredients are provided to hospitals, nursing care facilities and others as prepared, texture-adjusted foods for people with swallowing difficulties.
